title: Bug in a Tin
lines: Kim and Sid dig in the mud.
Sid digs up a big bug. "Look at it run," said Kim.
She had a tin cup. Sid let the bug hop in.
Kim set a lid on top. The bug bats at the lid.
"It is mad," said Sid. Kim tugs the lid up.
The bug ran to a log.
"It is at its den," said Kim. Sid nods. It was fun.
